objectives.title: Direct Data Subject Breach Notification
objectives.description: Contractual writings addressing notifications to affected natural persons following an incident.
criteria: Terms defining the high-risk threshold that triggers direct notification to data subjects.
Commitments ensuring notification occurs without undue delay.
Clear assignment of the data subject notification obligation to the controller.

objectives.title: Data Subject Communication Content
objectives.description: Contractual terms detailing information elements included within subject breach notices.
criteria: Inclusion of the nature of the security incident.
Identification of designated data protection contact points.
Descriptions of likely consequences of the incident.

objectives.title: Breach Notification Exemption Conditions
objectives.description: Writings governing exceptions eliminating the need for direct subject notification.
criteria: Documentation of technical and organisational protection measures, such as encryption, rendering the affected data unintelligible to unauthorised parties.
Implementation of subsequent measures ensuring the high risk is no longer likely to materialise.
Evaluation protocols for determining disproportionate notification effort.
Requirement for an alternative public communication or equally effective measure when direct notification is exempted for disproportionate effort.
